name: @restatedev/sessions
description: Session objects on Restate: virtual objects with a SQL database per key, kept in the object's state (ctx.db)

scripts.build: cargo build --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && node native/copy-addon.ts release
scripts.build:debug: cargo build --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && node native/copy-addon.ts debug
scripts.lint:rust: cd native && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.build:dist: cargo build --locked --profile dist --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && node native/copy-addon.ts dist
scripts.build:ts: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
